name: Microwave banana oats
directions: Mix oats with enough water to cover in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in short intervals until soft, then stir in sliced banana and peanut butter.

name: No-cook banana oat bowl
directions: Use oats labeled suitable for an uncooked preparation. Mix them with water until moistened. Add sliced banana and peanut butter. Eat promptly.

name: Microwave eggs and potato
directions: Pierce the potato and microwave until tender. Beat eggs in a microwave-safe mug and cook in short bursts, stirring until fully set. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Tuna and apple plate
directions: Open and drain the tuna. Slice the apple and serve with peanut butter. Eat the opened tuna promptly.

name: Cold bean and tuna bowl
directions: Open and drain both cans. Mix the beans and tuna in a bowl, season if available, and eat promptly.

name: Cold bean and tomato bowl
directions: Open and drain the beans. Mix with the tomatoes, season if available, and eat the opened cans promptly.

name: Microwave potato and beans
directions: Pierce and microwave the potato until tender. Heat the drained beans with the barbecue sauce in a microwave-safe bowl and serve over the potato.

name: Hotplate rice and beans
directions: Soak the dry beans, then boil them until fully tender. Cook the rice separately. Heat the tomatoes and combine everything.

name: Hotplate lentil tomato stew
directions: Rinse lentils and chop carrots. Simmer with the tomatoes and enough water until lentils and carrots are tender.

name: Hotplate pasta and vegetables
directions: Boil the pasta. Cook the frozen vegetables and heat the tomatoes in a pan. Season with Italian seasoning, mix, and top with parmesan.

name: Oven corn muffins and eggs
directions: Prepare the muffin mix with the milk and one egg, following the package's oven directions. Bake until done. Crack the second egg into a lightly greased oven-safe ramekin and bake until fully set; serve together.

name: Soup and crackers

name: Two bean and cheese burritos

name: Pepperoni pizza portion

name: Soy egg rice

name: Kidney bean chili

name: Lentil chili

name: Chili mac

name: Chili baked potato

directions: Rinse the lentils. Peel and dice the sweet potato and chop the onion. Simmer with the tomatoes and enough water to cover until the lentils and sweet potato are tender. Finish with a splash of lemon juice.

directions: Soak the dry beans, drain them, and boil them in fresh water until fully tender. Add chopped onion, sliced carrots, and chili powder, and simmer until the carrots are tender.

directions: Prepare the soup with water according to the label. Warm a tortilla with shredded cheddar in a skillet until the cheese melts. Serve with the soup.

name: Breakfast burrito with salsa
directions: Heat one burrito using the package's microwave directions until it is hot throughout, and top it with salsa.

directions: Boil the macaroni and drain it. Cook the frozen broccoli as directed. Toss the macaroni with butter, broccoli, and shredded cheddar until the cheese melts.

directions: Boil the macaroni and drain it. Prepare the tomato soup with water according to the label, stir in the macaroni, and top with shredded cheddar.

directions: Cook the rice. Heat the soup according to the label and stir in the rice.

name: Chicken and rice soup with tomatoes and crackers
directions: Heat the soup according to the label. Rinse the cherry tomatoes and serve them on the side with crackers.

name: Vegetable beef soup over a baked potato
directions: Scrub and pierce the potato and microwave it until tender. Heat the soup according to its label, split the potato, and spoon the soup over it.

name: Minestrone and crackers

name: Potato soup with corn
directions: Prepare the potato soup according to the label. Drain the corn, stir it in, and heat until hot.

name: Ramen with egg and cabbage
directions: Bring water to a boil and add shredded cabbage. Add the noodles and seasoning, following the package. Cook the egg separately until the white and yolk are firm, then add it to the bowl.

name: Spicy noodle cup and orange
directions: Heat water on the stovetop and prepare the noodle cup according to its label. Add hot sauce to taste. Peel the orange and serve it on the side.

name: Rice noodles with egg and vegetables
directions: Prepare the rice noodles as directed. Scramble the egg until fully set and cook the frozen vegetables as directed. Toss everything with soy sauce.

name: Tuna mac and cheese
directions: Prepare the macaroni and cheese using the milk and butter called for on the box. Drain the tuna and stir it in.

name: Crunchy chili tacos
directions: Heat the chili until steaming. Spoon it into the taco shells and top with shredded cheddar and chopped romaine.

directions: Bake the nuggets according to their package directions. Wash the carrots, cut them into sticks, and serve with dressing for the carrots and barbecue sauce for the nuggets.

name: Chili cheese fries
directions: Bake the fries according to the package. Heat the chili in a covered oven-safe dish while the fries bake, until steaming. Spoon the chili over the fries and top with shredded cheddar.

name: Berry ice cream sundae
directions: Thaw berries labeled ready to eat as directed. Spoon them over the ice cream and drizzle with chocolate syrup.

name: Egg and cheese quesadilla
directions: Scramble the egg until fully set. Fold it into a tortilla with shredded cheddar and warm in a skillet until the cheese melts.

name: Scratch pancakes
directions: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Whisk in the milk, egg, and oil just until combined. Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat, flipping when bubbles form, until both sides are golden and the centers are cooked through. Serve with syrup. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Cornmeal pancakes
directions: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Whisk in the milk, egg, and oil. Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat, flipping once, until both sides are golden and the centers are cooked through. Serve with syrup. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Cheesy cornmeal porridge
directions: Bring 2 cups of water and the salt to a boil. Whisk in the cornmeal slowly, lower the heat, and simmer, stirring often, about 15 minutes, until thick and soft. Stir in the butter and shredded cheddar.

name: Drop biscuits and baked eggs
directions: Heat the oven to 450 °F. Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt, then cut in the cold butter until crumbly. Stir in the milk just until combined, drop 8 mounds onto a baking sheet, and bake 10 to 12 minutes, until golden. Bake one egg per serving in a greased oven-safe ramekin until the white and yolk are fully set, and sprinkle the eggs with paprika. Serve the biscuits with honey. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Cinnamon rolls
directions: Warm the milk to about 110 °F and stir in the yeast and sugar. Mix in the egg, half the butter (melted), salt, and flour, and knead until smooth. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Roll into a rectangle, spread with the remaining soft butter, and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up, cut into 8 rolls, and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Berry muffins
directions: Heat the oven to 400 °F and grease a muffin pan. Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the milk, oil, egg, and vanilla just until combined, then fold in the berries while still frozen. Fill 6 cups and bake 18 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Scratch cornbread and chili
directions: Heat the oven to 400 °F and grease an 8-inch pan. Mix the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the milk, egg, and oil just until combined. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Heat the chili in a covered oven-safe dish until steaming and serve with the cornbread. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Homemade cheese pizza
directions: Stir the yeast and sugar into 1 cup of warm water (about 110 °F) and let it stand 5 minutes. Mix in the flour, salt, and oil, knead until smooth, cover, and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Heat the oven to 450 °F. Press the dough onto an oiled pan, top with tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and shredded cheddar, and bake 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Homemade bread and peanut butter
directions: Stir the yeast and sugar into 1 1/4 cups of warm water (about 110 °F) and let it stand 5 minutes. Mix in the oil, salt, and flour, and knead about 8 minutes, until smooth. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Shape into a loaf, place in a greased loaf pan, and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and hollow-sounding when tapped. Cool, slice, and spread with peanut butter. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Homemade tortillas with beans and cheese
directions: Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the oil and about 3/4 cup of warm water to make a soft dough. Divide into 8 balls, rest 10 minutes, and roll thin. Cook each in a dry skillet over medium-high heat until both sides have browned spots. Warm the beans as directed on the can and fill two tortillas per serving with beans and cheddar. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Banana bread
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F and grease a loaf pan. Mash the bananas, then stir in the oil, egg, sugar, and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon just until combined. Bake 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Cool before slicing. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Peanut butter cookies
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F. Mix the peanut butter, both sugars, egg, and vanilla, then stir in the flour and baking soda. Roll into 1-inch balls, flatten with a fork on an ungreased baking sheet, and bake 9 to 11 minutes, until set at the edges. Cool on the sheet. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Oatmeal cookies
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F. Beat the soft butter and brown sugar, then mix in the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt, then the oats. Drop rounded spoonfuls onto a baking sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden. Don't taste the raw dough.

name: Cocoa brownies
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F and grease an 8-inch pan. Whisk the oil, sugar, eggs, and vanilla. Stir in the cocoa, flour, baking powder, and salt just until combined. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until the center is set and a toothpick comes out with only a few moist crumbs. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Chocolate snack cake
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F and grease an 8-inch pan. Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, and salt. Stir in the oil, vanilla, and 1 cup of water until smooth. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Don't taste the raw batter.

name: Homemade hot cocoa
directions: Whisk the cocoa and sugar into a little of the milk until smooth, then whisk in the rest. Heat until steaming, without boiling, and stir in the vanilla.

name: Cinnamon apple crisp
directions: Heat the oven to 350 °F. Slice the apples into a baking dish. Mix the oats, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon, then rub in the soft butter until crumbly and scatter it over the apples. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until the apples are tender and the topping is golden.
